name: FGR5
status: frozen confirmatory test; design and scoring code pushed before the fresh trajectories are generated
purpose: Test on new fresh trajectories whether (C1) a transfer-operator estimate built from one-cycle evaluations of the reconstructed departure coordinate predicts the per-departure termination rate, (C2) the per-bin termination fractions are calibrated on observed departures, and (C3) the unwrapped FGR3 table predicts return time and unwrapped departure time on the two long resolved runs.
storage: All full-state updates in immutable 128-update shards outside Git, copied, fsynced and rehashed on /archive before advancing (the FGR3 Evidence class). Never splice failed attempts.

fresh.initial_rule: One uniform draw within each of 48 strata along the FGR1 seed-64-to-seed-77 transverse line (the FGR3 rule with a new seed and three times the rows).
fresh.stop: 128 consecutive ordered full-state matches to the audited period-3 orbit at relative 1e-9, another recurrence candidate, or 16384 updates. No stopping on returns.

prediction.source: FGR4 uniform bases only (role base), computed by tools/fold_return_escape.py predict after FGR4 completes; prediction.json hash committed in docs/fold-return-fgr5-prediction.json before scoring.
prediction.estimator: Ulam matrix on 28 equal bins of [3, 4.12]; termination = verified period-3 approach or other recurrence candidate; censored bases excluded and counted; kappa = 1 - spectral radius; 2000 bootstrap resamples within bins (seed 20261114). Sensitivity with 14 and 56 bins reported, not scored.

criteria.C1: Let D be the fresh departures whose next outcome was observed and C the terminations that follow a departure. Passed if the predicted kappa lies inside the exact 95% Poisson (Garwood) interval of C divided by D.
criteria.C2: Passed if the sum over those D departures of the predicted termination fraction of the departure's bin lies inside the Garwood 95% interval of C.
criteria.C3: For fresh returns whose departure q lies in [3.0, 3.0503125] or [3.56, 4.12], the unwrapped FGR3 table (tools/fold_return_unwrap.py, reset at each observed departure) must give the correct return time for at least 97% of them, median |tau error| <= 0.002 and 99th percentile <= 0.05 channel steps.

reporting: All three criteria are reported whether they pass or fail, with the number of trajectories censored at 16384 updates. Development values (FGR3 fresh trajectories, already seen) are reported separately and are not part of the test.
claims: One prompt and parameter setting. Trajectories on one constructed line are the independent units; departures within a trajectory are not independent, so the Poisson interval is approximate. A passed C1 supports a statistical one-coordinate description of the capture rate, not pointwise prediction in M.
publication: Report, article and blog updates only after audit; no paid computation.
